scenes.title: Don't buy these Jeep Cherokee XJ years

scenes.body: No 4.0 until 1987: Off Road Xtreme recommends staying away from 1984–86 trucks.
New '0331' cylinder head: early castings can crack between cylinders 3 and 4 and put coolant in the oil (Wikipedia).
The HO is the XJ Off Road Xtreme recommends: easier to diagnose than the Renix 4.0, and more power.
